impact.text: Phantom shares “steal” a significant proportion of the vault’s value

precondition_sources.text: At deployment, HypoVault initializes totalSupply with 1,000,000 shares without allocating them to any address.
The 1,000,000 bootstrap shares exist in totalSupply but are not owned by anyone.

intent_sources.text: Bootstrap shares should be removed so that no unowned shares inflate totalSupply.
